title: Normative data for insulin-like growth factor-1 and insulin-like growth factor binding protein-3 and their determinants in healthy adult males from india: the INDIIGo study | Scientific Reports
abstract: The INDIIGo study aimed to establish normative data for serum insulin-like growth factor-1 (IGF-1) and insulin-like growth factor binding protein-3 (IGFBP-3) in adult Indian males, addressing the paucity of data for the South East Asian population. We recently published normative data of IGF1 on children from India22.") and in view of lack of normative data of IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 in Indian adults, we planned the present study to generate the normative data for serum IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 (INDIIGo) in healthy Indian adult males using the Roche Elecsys® electrochemiluminescence immunoassay (ECLIA)22."). The aim of the INDIIGo study was to establish normative data for serum IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 in apparently healthy adult males aged 20-65.9 years in Chandigarh, a cosmopolitan city in northern India. The INDIIGo study is, to the best of our knowledge, the first to generate normative data for serum IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 in apparently healthy Indian adults.
